properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses RSA for signing (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) in the browser extension's key generation script. This is a quantum-vulnerable algorithm that should be migrated to ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The project uses constant-time comparison for MAC/digest verification in the verification workers. This is good cryptographic practice and not a vulnerability.
